merged_issues.title: Missing or empty document title
merged_issues.description: The page does not contain a non-empty <title> element. Screen reader users rely on the title to understand what the page is, and it is also important for navigation and search results.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Add a descriptive, non-empty <title> element inside <head>, e.g. <title>Page name – Site name</title>, and ensure it is unique per page.

merged_issues.title: Prohibited ARIA attribute used on element without a valid role
merged_issues.description: A <div> with no valid role uses aria-label. This is flagged as a prohibited ARIA attribute usage for the element/role combination, which can prevent assistive technologies from correctly interpreting the control.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Use a semantic control (preferred) such as <button class="menu-btn" aria-label="Menu">…</button>. If a non-semantic element must be used, add an appropriate role (e.g., role="button"), ensure it is keyboard operable (Enter/Space), and provide an accessible name.
